id: title:CShine612:name the failing tables on warehouse readiness

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper `_source_summary_detail` that lists failed table names and truncates long lists with an ellipsis; P3 replaces the static detail lookup with this dynamic one.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes warehouse status messages more informative by naming failing tables rather than using generic text.

observations.behavior: Captures an analytics event when a user opens the schema list for a managed warehouse source. Also adds a clickable link to open it directly instead of only via row click.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides telemetry on warehouse interaction and improves discoverability without changing backend behavior.

observations.limitations: The tier is bounded: no changes to query execution, ingestion reliability or identity consistency are shown; benefits are limited to better diagnostics and optional UI improvements.

review.limitations: The tier is bounded: no changes to query execution, ingestion reliability or identity consistency are shown; benefits are limited to better diagnostics and optional UI improvements.
review.reason: Substantive improvement in diagnostic clarity and workflow usability demonstrated through implementation and tests; not broad enough for tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps users identify which warehouse tables require attention and understand failure reasons.
